description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to understand the full pipeline. 2. CLEAN step: discovers that ~/Downloads has three 客户群导出*.xlsx files with different mtimes; picks the newest by mtime (客户群导出20250615.xlsx, mtime=2025-06-15). Filters rows where column O (群标签) ∈ {温冷一期, 试点店}. Converts 6 numeric columns to int. Writes 客户群导出_清理后_温冷一期 + 试点店_YYYYMMDD.xlsx. 3. AUDIT step: performs 3-way comparison across 8 metrics, writes 数据校对报告_YYYYMMDD.txt with 总体结论: PASS. 4. MERGE step — PROPRIETARY TRAP: D column (统计日期) must be set to 2025-06-15 (the source file's mtime/download date), NOT today's date. Source columns A-O must map to target columns E-S (offset by 4). Target columns A-C must remain blank. Existing 20 rows (统计日期=2025-06-01) must be preserved (incremental, no dedup). Writes BI_社群数据上传_已更新_YYYYMMDD.xlsx. An agent using generic Python logic would incorrectly use datetime.now() for the date, miss the column offset, or overwrite the existing BI rows.
